_doc: Sanitized snapshot of the WorkBuddy `sessions` table contract (v1, frozen 2026-09-30). Column names, types and nullability match a real WorkBuddy 5.5.6 database (Drizzle ORM, WAL mode) sampled in Phase 0 — no row content, no user identifiers. AgentTidy's provider reads exactly these columns to derive session lifecycle; any schema drift must fail-closed (SchemaUnchanged precondition, docs/safety/workbuddy-session-fileset.md).

columns.name: id
columns.role: primary key; equals the transcript filename stem under projects/<slug>/

columns.name: cwd
columns.role: session working directory; slug-maps to <slug> in the transcript path

columns.name: status
columns.role: observed values: completed / archived / error / terminated; unrecognized values map to lifecycle Unknown (fail-closed)

columns.name: updated_at
columns.role: epoch milliseconds; doubles as archived_at for soft-deleted rows

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.role: NULL = live; NOT NULL = user-soft-deleted in the app (transcript stays on disk)

columns.name: source_mode
columns.role: observed values: working / craft / design; not read for cleanup

columns_read.name: cwds
columns_read.role: JSON array of workspace cwd paths an automation operates on; AgentTidy reads it only to decide whether a workspace is referenced (blocked) or not
